name: Tailscale
description: The machines on your tailnet for Odysseus: Settings > Devices, model discovery, Ping, and a Machines tab. Read only.
author: Jaron Wilson

steps.title: Your machines, from Tailscale
steps.body: This add-on reads the tailnet with this server's `tailscale` command. Odysseus uses it for **Settings > Devices**, to find model servers on your other machines and for **Ping**. Without it, MCP servers and devices you add by hand still work.

steps.title: The Machines tab
steps.body:
Every machine with its OS, address and when it was last seen, plus what **Tailscale Serve** and **Funnel** publish from this server. It only reads: it never changes Tailscale, Serve or Funnel.

Nothing shows? Install Tailscale on the server and sign in (`tailscale up`) yourself.

steps.title: Ask the agent
steps.body: In a chat, ask *which of my machines are online?* or *ping my laptop over tailscale*.
